claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings (CMV/ASSIST/AutoFlow, PEEP 5 cmH2O, set tidal volume 450 mL, set respiratory rate 16) and monitor airway pressures and minute ventilation.
Continue invasive hemodynamic monitoring with arterial line and pulmonary artery catheter, including periodic zeroing/calibration and trending of pressures.
Continue temporary pacemaker with atrial and ventricular wires at current settings (rate 60 bpm) and monitor sensing/stimulation thresholds.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin infusion per protocol, with fingerstick glucose checks and titration.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit and hemodynamic status, with a low threshold to evaluate for and treat anemia if clinically indicated.
Continue vasoactive and antihypertensive infusions (phenylephrine, nitroglycerin, nicardipine) with titration to blood pressure goals and continuous hemodynamic monitoring.
Monitor coagulation parameters (PT/INR, PTT, fibrinogen, platelets) and assess for bleeding risk.
Monitor electrolytes (potassium, ionized calcium, sodium, chloride) and renal function (creatinine, BUN) with replacement as indicated.
Perform sedation and delirium assessment (Richmond-RAS, CAM-ICU) and manage sedation to target Richmond-RAS 0.
Perform pressure injury risk assessment (Braden) and implement skin care and repositioning per Braden score.
